verdict.rationale: Sill has no vendor rendezvous or relay to self-host. Its docs state there is no account and no server, so screen and keystroke traffic travel only between your own devices. Remote Access runs over your own VPN or a port you forward on your router, which keeps session traffic on infrastructure you run. Missing for 10: any self-hostable relay or rendezvous component for setups without a VPN or port forward, independent or hands-on corroboration that no traffic leaves your devices, and deployment docs for admin-run networking.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the rendezvous or relay infrastructure so session traffic stays on infrastructure I run

citations.quote: There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
Remote Access lets you use your Mac away from home, through your own VPN, such as Tailscale, or through a port you forward on your router.
Direct Wireless Connection lets an iPhone or iPad near your Mac connect without a shared Wi-Fi network, the way AirDrop does.
